Let me try interacting with the notice board by facing it from a position. Since I can't move, maybe I need to read it. Let me try pressing E while facing up (toward 2,6) — did that. 

New idea: maybe the game uses a different control scheme and my KeyW etc. aren't the movement keys in this context. But body_controls confirms KeyW/A/S/D move. And earlier the walk_to "played held direction buttons" and got "interrupted: blocked" — so movement IS being attempted but blocked.

The notice board is the blocker. I'm on its tile. This seems like an unwinnable trap UNLESS the notice board can be read/removed. Let me try pressing E while facing the board — but the board is at my tile. 

Wait, maybe the board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7) but actually the board occupies a tile and I'm standing on the SAME tile which shouldn't be possible. Perhaps the real fix: the board is at (2,7) and I'm at (2,7) means I'm INSIDE it. Let me try pressing E to "read notice" — maybe the game reads the notice on my current tile when I press E with nothing in front.

Let me try pressing E while facing down (2,8 empty) — got "nothing at 2,8". So E only checks facing tile.

Let me try a diagonal or check if there's a way to interact with own tile. Let me look at whether the notice board might be readable via a different key. Let me check body_controls again — only KeyE interacts.

Let me try walking to the workbench directly with adjacent mode — maybe the pathfinder finds a route I'm missing.
